question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Morose
solution:
The correct answer is: **Uplifted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Morose"** means being sullen, gloomy, or in a bad mood. (उदास)

 
 
• **Example: **He became **morose** after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **"Uplifted"** refers to being in high spirits, feeling happy and cheerful. (उत्साहित)
 
 
• **Example: **She felt uplifted by the kind words of her friends.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'morose' **is **'uplifted'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Uplifted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cranky** (चिड़चिड़ा): Easily annoyed or irritable.

 
 
• **Example:** She gets cranky when she doesn't get enough sleep.
 
 
 
• **Glum** (उदास): Looking or feeling dejected; morose.
 
 
• **Example:** He looked glum after losing the game.
 
 
 
• **Gloomy** (अंधकारमय): Dark or poorly lit, especially so as to appear depressing or frightening.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather was gloomy and rainy all day.
